presets.name: Inspect CodeBERT pair
presets.description: Compare two public CodeBERT variants. Shows the pairwise task-vector cosine similarity, sign-agreement, and base-architecture compatibility check.

presets.name: TIES merge (clone detection)
presets.description: TIES-Merging across three public encoders as a demo. Swap the model picks for your own fine-tunes (Library tab → Upload) to get a usable clone detector.

presets.name: DARE-TIES merge (vulnerability detection)
presets.description: DARE-TIES across two public encoders as a demo. For real vulnerability detection, upload Devign/ReVeal fine-tunes (safetensors) via the Library tab and swap them in.

presets.name: WUDI merge (clone detection)
presets.description: WUDI-Merging across two public encoders as a demo (300 steps, lr 1e-5). Interference-minimising per-layer optimisation. Upload your BCB/CLCDSA fine-tunes for a usable clone detector.

presets.name: PCB merge (clone detection)
presets.description: PCB-Merging across three public encoders as a demo. Balances intra-task parameter significance against cross-task competition, keeping the top 10% of scores. Upload your own fine-tunes for a real clone detector.

presets.name: Cross-task encoder merge (demo)
presets.description: Encoder-only DARE-TIES across three public SE encoders. Demonstrates the --encoder-only path for merging checkpoints with mismatched classifier heads; upload your task-specific fine-tunes to re-create the paper setup.

presets.name: Evaluate on BigCloneBench
presets.description: Evaluate a merged clone detector on the bundled BigCloneBench sample.

presets.name: Evaluate on CLCDSA (cross-language)
presets.description: Evaluate a merged clone detector on the bundled CLCDSA cross-language sample (Java↔Python).

presets.name: Evaluate on GPTCloneBench
presets.description: Evaluate a merged clone detector on the bundled GPTCloneBench semantic-clone sample.
